[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **15-Minute Meals**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. One-Pot Pasta: Cook pasta, tomato sauce, and favorite protein in one pot.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Tacos: Use pre-cooked ground beef, shredded cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Omelette: Whip up an omelette with eggs, cheese, and favorite fillings.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **30-Minute Meals**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stir-Fry: Cook protein and veggies in a wok or skillet with oil and soy sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Grilled Chicken and Veggies: Marinate chicken and grill with pre-cut veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Lentil Soup: Sauté onions, carrots, and celery, then add lentils, broth, and tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **5-Ingredient Meals**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Grilled Cheese and Tomato Sandwich: Add fresh tomato slices and spinach.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chicken and Avocado Salad: Mix diced chicken, avocado, lettuce, and cherry tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Quesadilla: Fill tortillas with cheese, beans, and favorite protein.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Meal Prep Ideas**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Slow Cooker Meals: Prepare a recipe on the weekend for the week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Prep a Protein: Cook a large batch of chicken, beans, or lentils.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Roasted Veggies: Roast a large batch of veggies on the weekend.
